Inspected the cited rule or publisher declaration at Core 1.0 §§3.3.2.2 and 4.4.2.2, select validation and reduction. WebAssembly Core 1.0 `select` takes two operands of the same value type and an `i32` condition. It returns the first operand for a nonzero condition and the second operand for zero. The instruction has passed validation and the three inputs are present in its specified operand order. This selects between values already on the operand stack. It does not specify conditional evaluation of the instructions producing them. Validation accepts one shared value type for the two options and a distinct i32 condition slot. Execution pops the second candidate before the first. A nonzero condition chooses the earlier candidate, including values other than 1.
